findings.summary: Base UI transformer gives button semantics to button-styled links (PaginationLink renders an anchor through Button).
Base UI PaginationLink hydrates with mismatched data-slot (button vs pagination-link).
Closed PR 'preserve pagination link semantics' (also 11822), so the base registry file may still lack the fix.

notChecked: mui/base-ui tracker search returned nothing relevant

differences.branch: base-nova pagination.json differs from radix-nova only in this: <Button nativeButton={false} render={<a .../>} />. Radix Button (kept on Radix by C-button) has no render/nativeButton props, so it would not typecheck and would not render the anchor.
differences.how: diff radix-nova and base-nova pagination.json from ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/*/pagination.json

differences.branch: Upstream reports Base UI Button on a link adds button semantics (issue 11624). Not verified locally because the swap is not possible without Base UI Button.
differences.how: See the issue; not run locally.

apiChanges: asChild -> render + nativeButton={false} (would need Base UI Button)
notes: Pagination has no Radix primitive; the only Radix-vs-Base difference is the Button interop. Screenshot and interaction comparison not run: no migrated build can exist while Button stays on Radix, so the branch would be identical to the reference or fail to compile. Registry files are otherwise identical (same deps: cn, button).
reasonNotMoved: Pagination's only Radix-to-Base change is how it wraps Button (asChild versus render with nativeButton={false}). Button stays on Radix (see C-button), so the Base UI pagination file cannot compile or render against it, and upstream reports Base UI link-as-Button semantics and data-slot hydration bugs (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/11624, https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/11489). Retry after Button moves to Base UI and those issues are fixed; the swap is then mechanical.
